name: Constellation Barrier reduces all Magic damage taken by 5% (#1532)
contract: Constellation Barrier 300259 (Spell.dbc, passive) has one effect: SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87, the issue labels it 'Mod Power Regen' by mistake), EffectMiscValue 126 (0x7E: the Holy, Fire, Nature, Frost, Shadow and Arcane school bits, not Physical), EffectBasePoints -6 with DieSides 1 -> -5, matching the tooltip 'Reduces all Magic damage taken by 5%.'. Nothing in the module or SQL touches 300259. Native path: Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken multiplies TakenTotalMod by GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN) over effects whose misc value intersects the spell's school mask. The spell_damage_taken metric calls SpellDamageBonusTaken(attacker, spell, 1000, SPELL_DIRECT_DAMAGE) with no hit roll, crit or mitigation. Fixture spells: Arcane Blast 30451 (SchoolMask 64), Fireball 133 (4) and Frostbolt 116 (16) must each fall to 0.95 (949-950 of 1000, band 0.94-0.96); Heroic Strike 78 (SchoolMask 1, Physical) must stay at 1.0 because 1 & 126 is empty. Both fixtures are the same race, class and level and the same creature is the attacker for both readings.
